changelog:
Initial release of self-love-confidence.

- Offers personalized affirmations in five dimensions: self-worth, capability, body, relationships, and growth
- Lets you log daily wins and accomplishments to track progress and boost positivity
- Provides tools to reframe negative self-talk and manage the inner critic compassionately
- Includes confidence tracking across multiple areas, with visual progress review over time
- Designed with privacy in mind: all data remains local on your device
summary: Build self-love and confidence with affirmations, wins logging, and inner critic management
